steps: Write the correct formula of each substance

Check every element and add state symbols

questions.prompt: Explain why a chemical equation must be balanced.
questions.modelAnswer: In a chemical reaction atoms are only rearranged: none are created or destroyed (law of conservation of mass). So the total number of atoms of each element must be the same in the reactants and products. A balanced equation shows this and lets us work out the amounts that react.
rubric: Same number of each atom on both sides
